restrictions: Two distinct 64-byte messages M(x), M(y). W0..W7 are the fixed prefix in proof Section 1. W8=y0, W9=y1, and W10..W15 are y2..y7 minus K10..K15 modulo 2^32. This is a bijection from the 256-bit chain value x. FIPS padding adds one fixed second block. The target uses the standard IV, steps 0..40 on each block, and feed-forward. The walk g is an explicitly invertible encoding of the block-1 working state (walk B with tail shear masks QM=0x9f5937e8 and XM=0xeaab0b62) XOR the fixed polarity mask 148a004430b746c9e01d4dfb0cc5bf671d4f25b8601a6eab227bb195b5b60ae1. A collision of g gives equal complete digests.

Classical 256-bit word RAM under collision-frontier-v5, C=2980. The declared machine has 889 256-bit registers, 884 data, three pointers, and the stage-1 counter and all-ones register. Every XOR, AND, OR, NOT, move, set, load, store, addition, comparison, branch, and random word is charged. Its native body instruction is exactly 32 bits: a 2-bit opcode and three 10-bit register fields, fetched and executed directly at one operation per instruction under the same pricing convention as the accepted native 5-byte format. No decoder or interpreter runs in the normative path. Recovery and control use native fixed 5-byte instructions. The kernel has 45302 instructions (35482 XOR, 6049 AND, 3771 OR; the 45311-instruction kernel of cda94445 after nine exact one-gate window rewrites applied in place by the emitter, three of them after live-range renames, proof Section 1 item (5) and Section D).

Stage 1 is the weighted cascade of proof Section C. Direct accumulator initialization computes the exact same OR of the first ten planes with 9 ORs plus the unchanged guard envelope, reducing the unconditional charge from 11 to 10 operations; loop control adds 3, so the body is 45315 operations per batch. The conditional levels (planes 10 to 19, guard check and final NOT) are unchanged and paid through the capped weighted counter U + 30 = 2678064869068096623746628580370015209.

The single attempt uses one fresh uniform r, no restart, no amplification, no stored collision, and no advice. Distinguished points have low 20 bits zero and the next 102 bits below 2132. The table stores 137977 completed trails in 138240 trail-index slots. Each 47-bit slot stores key+1 in a bit-sliced table of 540 groups of 47 aligned 256-bit words (256 trail numbers per group); zero is the empty sentinel, and the slot position is the trail number. Recovery resolves collisions by two-pass checkpoint binary search (cap cr=30923878325953014679188006655677811, kchk=12689, stride D=2437061890294981060697297395830) and uses the 466-record rolled program (78 one-time initialization records), executing 1453 records per call plus at most 39 itemized surrounding operations, including 10 per-call register re-sets.

Exact ledger: B=1324588912053250000000000000000000000, c=87285140436157702723514534915219626, cr=30923878325953014679188006655677811, and N=60074435816065403106810366381900294477380 word operations. log2(N/2980)=123.922778374616. The claim rounds upward to 123.92278. The main loop charges B*45315; a stage-1 cascade row charges U+30 = 2678064869068096623746628580370015209 (capped weighted counter; proof Section C). Final setup and emission cost 204877613 operations. The 1641-evaluation offset search costs 461900436782186496 operations. The reserved 427-evaluation selector-validation envelope costs 120189815055450112 operations. All are included in N and preprocessing_log2.

Search memory is 191278 bytes of code, 812160 bytes of table, 16384 bytes of counters and copies, and 28448 bytes of registers: 1048270 bytes. The 2112-byte recovery array lies inside the 8192-byte plane copy that is part of the counters; that copy is dead when recovery starts (proof Appendix B.1). The table is 540 groups of 47 aligned 32-byte words (proof Section 3.3.1). Normative setup adds a 371952-byte wasm emitter image and 79798 bytes of itemized scratch to the final code, counters, and registers: 687860 bytes. The sequential preprocessing searches peak below setup. Search is the overall peak. The self-test asserts every body, control, key, and trail field boundary. The shipped candidate module source is 65,420 bytes and is included inside the 191,278-byte persistent code allocation that is part of the 1,048,270-byte overall peak; it is not additional memory. The executable record calculation is 5 bytes smaller, but this filing retains the parent envelope.

For a uniformly random 256-bit function, proof Section 4 and Appendix A give P_F at least 0.390000001000 using exact integers and outward-rounded 60-digit decimals. H1 is the score-critical comparison that transfers this bound to the fixed reduced-round SHA-256 walk. Proof Section 5 states its support, scope, and exact sensitivity.

The freestanding C source embedded as GEN_C (SHA-256 0722af621f17ed139bda6610b1d1900592fd485ed6212df8de5c4b87aa85c32c) is the normative setup emitter. Circuit optimizations are exact equivalences checked by the self-test; they are not premises.

The declared organizer experiments are consistency checks. bssha-n16 performs one width-16 search attempt per trial. proj-k0-w256 evaluates 256 full-width points and forms the complete two-block 41-step digest. The organizer recomputes every returned event. No experiment count changes the score.

heuristics.statement: Model premise with four explicit clauses. Let F be a uniformly random function from 256-bit values to 256-bit values and let A_F be this exact bounded attempt with every call to the fixed walk g replaced by lazy sampling from F. H1 states that the real attempt succeeds at least as often as A_F. (a) Distinct fresh evaluated inputs have independent uniform outputs and pair-collision hazard 2^-256. (b) Iterates from the starts r+t have the first-collision law of a random mapping. (c) A fresh output is distinguished with probability 2132/2^122 independently of collision events. (d) Under the program's adaptive choices, given the complete earlier history and the later DP flags, a fresh output equals any fixed earlier non-DP output with probability at least 2^-256. Proof Section 4 proves P_F >= 0.390000001000 for F, and Section 5 states the support and sensitivity of the fixed-target comparison.
heuristics.scope: The scope is exactly sha256-r41-prefix-v1, the 64-byte message family of proof Section 1, one attempt of B=1324588912053250000000000000000000000 batches and Q=339094761485632000000000000000000000000 evaluations, about 135971.79 trails of mean length 5316911983139663491615228241121378304/2132 = 2^110.9420, with 256 trails advanced together.
heuristics.extrapolation: Support of H1 is stated in proof Section 5. (1) H1 is the generic premise of parallel collision search with distinguished points: Paul C. van Oorschot and Michael J. Wiener, 'Parallel Collision Search with Cryptanalytic Applications', Journal of Cryptology 12(1):1-28, 1999, DOI 10.1007/PL00003816, model a fixed compression function iterated from fresh starts, without a chosen input difference, by a random function. The generic entries of this track use the same premise, including the round-64 entries 7523902c and c9ae3732 and the round-41 entries e08e7b6a and 7347a2b6. (2) Clause (d) fails adversely only if g, along its own iterates, collides less often than a random function by a factor 1-eps. Such a property would separate this 41-step SHA-256 walk from a random function in a way no published result shows; this entry chooses no input difference and uses no differential property. (3) A higher hazard helps. Replanning a deficit costs 0.00725124 bit at eps=0.01 (Tp 2121), 0.03700836 at eps=0.05 (Tp 2078), 0.07585444 at eps=0.10 (Tp 2022), and 0.20738722 at eps=0.25 (Tp 1846). (4) The program checks agree with random-function references at their scopes: proj-k0-w256 expects 100.53 of 256 trials with a pair; bssha-n16 expects 178.14 of 256 (exact-plan lazy-random-function reference, 10000000 mappings, probability 0.6958435, standard error 0.00014548). cda94445 reported a participant-run 256-trial replay with substitute seeds that returned 106 and 175. For this package a 48-trial replay with substitute seeds returned 20 (proj-k0-w256) and 35 (bssha-n16) trials with a pair, byte-identical to the outputs of the cda94445 source on the same requests, every pair recomputed with the verifier digest. These counts are consistency checks, not inputs to the score.
heuristics.limitations: Measured experiments cover the complete search at width 16 and 16-bit projections of 256 full-width points. Full-width collision hazard and success probability at 2^128 scale remain explicit extrapolations under H1. The exact sensitivity costs above restore 0.39 under specified hazard deficits. Circuit equivalences, instruction counts, memory bounds, and the theorem for F are independent of H1. The memory layout of this package (the recovery array inside the plane copy, the bit-sliced table, the 1250-record handler allowance) consists of declared prices and a lifetime argument outside H1 (proof Appendix B.3).
